name: scene-skin
description: A story scene as a sheet of typed cells: the human fills situation facts (spoken); structure formulas, dice-drawn nudges and a resonance term accumulate the unspoken field; the word-smith LLM stretches the last-mile prose over the drum.

cells.prompt: Who is there? (a short figure description)
One object in their hands or on the table

cells.doc: how much light the situation admits (0 dark .. 1 bright)
presence weight of the figure from how specifically they are described
how much the object pulls focus
darker scenes lean toward dread; dice-drawn direction
a heavy object makes the strange more available
feedback term: the field listening to itself

cells.instruction: Write the scene: 3 to 5 sentences of prose. Weave the figure and the object in naturally. Let the nudge vector shade the prose — dread pulls imagery down and inward, longing opens it outward, uncanny lets one detail sit slightly wrong, resonance is the overall pressure. Do not name the axes or the numbers.
cells.fallback_shape: {figure} waits where {place} holds its {arrival}; the air is {adj}, and {object} keeps its weight.
cells.doc: the ONLY LLM cell — last-mile word-smithing over the accumulated unspoken field
